Comment "blueprint" and I'll send it to you 👇

Everything I've learned about AI video production condensed into one blueprint.

How to craft prompts that actually direct. How to avoid the uncanny, artificial look. How to produce visuals that feel cinematic, not generated.

AI videos that feel like movies. I made it because I'm tired of these generic AI videos.

The result is AI video that's built to perform for brands and products that need content that converts, not just content that exists.
